parser: page.extract_text(visitor_text=visitor), full pages joined by one newline; check exact font alignment

formulas.characters_without_whitespace: sum(not c.isspace() for c in text)

comparison_policy.written: whole L008+whole N016 divided by whole U_H+whole H1+whole H2, first comparison
comparison_policy.including_program: same source sum divided by whole written replacement+whole CODE, separate complete-program comparison
comparison_policy.raw_program_alternative: whole written replacement+both whole raw programs, alternative to CODE never additive
comparison_policy.conditional: each whole source / its whole application after acquiring whole U_H and both complete programs, with required/diagnostic roles distinct

calibration: Actual font dictionaries/effective encodings and original text events bind every repair. Visible form-feed vertical extensions and embedded Type3 bullets are preserved as glyphs; real/generated whitespace otherwise remains. No historical statement or software is corrected.
